rationale: Anders brings deep experience building AI-native developer tools and open source coding agents—exactly the kind of infrastructure that could power Sid's developer utilities and side projects. Both are based in San Francisco and share a focus on developer-tools, and Anders's background as a fractional CTO and repeat YC founder could offer practical guidance on taking side projects toward product-market fit.
intro_message: Anders Lie, meet Sid Kurra — Anders builds AI-native developer tools and open source coding agents, and has mentored early-stage engineers through fractional CTO work; Sid's actively shipping developer utilities and side projects in Python and JavaScript, and could benefit from Anders's perspective on scaling tools from zero to one.
